name: animal-kingdom-live
description: TikTok LIVE animal collection game and real-time overlay

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n SERVER,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @animal-kingdom/server" "npm run dev -w @animal-kingdom/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @animal-kingdom/server && npm run build -w @animal-kingdom/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @animal-kingdom/server && npm run typecheck -w @animal-kingdom/web
